summary.headline: HJ Shipbuilding & Construction amends Boryeong power plant contract to KRW 264.40bn
summary.what_happened: HJ Shipbuilding & Construction filed a corrected disclosure (dated Nov 24, 2026) for a single supply contract for the Boryeong Shinbokhap Unit 1 construction project, a 500MW combined-cycle power plant in Chungnam, Korea. The filing states that the contract amount was revised from KRW 264,532,406,137 to KRW 264,397,390,304, following a change contract executed on Nov 6, 2026. The counterparty is Korea Midland Power Co., Ltd., and the stated contract period runs from Sep 18, 2023 to Mar 31, 2027.
summary.why_it_matters: Large single supply or construction contracts disclosed in Korea are typically reported because their size relative to recent revenue is material to shareholders' understanding of a company's order backlog and future revenue. Corrections or amendments to such contracts are usually disclosed so investors can track changes to the stated contract value and terms.
